brief: Proposed Library is a two-storey public library in Hubli, prepared as a fifth-semester architectural design and working-drawing project at KLE’s C.I.M Polytechnic. The ground floor holds the public and support functions; the first floor is given to reading, group study and the auditorium. The building is planned as three angled wings around a central shared space.

paragraphs: The proposal is organised as three angled wings gathered around a central shared space. Rather than stacking every function along one corridor, each group of rooms has its own identifiable hall: public reading and periodicals, children’s activities, administration, and quiet/group study.

The ground floor forms the public layer — reception, the common reading and periodical hall, children’s section, canteen, offices and meeting room around the entrance and forecourt. The first floor forms the study layer — digital library, girls’, boys’ and group study halls, and the auditorium.

Externally, white and grey volumes with glazed end walls and a curved entrance canopy mark the approach. The landscaped garden, parking and open-air theatre occupy the remaining site, with the reading wings sitting between the forecourt and the garden.
